summary: Spec fidelity: L2.input-usage (input.rs:270-271) accepts, besides USAGE and the registered finer replacements the checker knows (UNKNOWN_OPTION, OPTION_REQUIRED), any code that is registered with exit 2 and does not start with INPUT_. --input given twice answered with PLAN_STALE, UNKNOWN_COMMAND or a tool's own precondition code passes. checker.md says 'USAGE or its registered finer replacement (spec 7.2.2)'; the set of finer replacements is not named, so the code widened it rather than guess. Weakens the one MUST that tells a malformed command line from a bad document. Blast radius: atip.checkl2input.07 seeds only INPUT_INVALID and a wrong field.
